source_caption:
Ricky Gervais makes After Life hit so hard because he doesn’t treat grief like something inspirational or clean. Tony is cruel, funny, broken, and brutally honest all at once — and the show works because it finds tenderness not by fixing his pain, but by showing the small human moments that keep him connected to the world.

After Life (2019–2022), created by Ricky Gervais, starring Ricky Gervais, Tom Basden, Tony Way. A darkly funny and deeply emotional series about grief, loneliness, and learning to live again after loss, balancing sharp humor with surprising warmth.
